name: saas-o-matic
description: Internal tool to simulate and quote multi-currency SaaS subscriptions for corporate customers.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @saas-o-matic/api && npm run build -w @saas-o-matic/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -p packages/domain && tsc -p packages/contract && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p tools && npm run typecheck -w @saas-o-matic/web
scripts.check: node scripts/check-filenames.mjs && node scripts/check-forbidden-patterns.mjs && depcruise packages apps/api/src apps/web/src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && vitest run --project domain --project contract --project api --project tools && npm run test -w @saas-o-matic/web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check && npm run build:packages && vitest run --coverage && npm run test -w @saas-o-matic/web && npm run build && npm run trace
